title: 前白宫副国安顾问：特朗普言论激化伊朗强硬派
speaker: Ben Rhodes

segments.en: You have, particularly on the U.S. side, I think, President Trump sensitive to criticism and sometimes he goes out and he says it makes threats against the Iranian delegation or he's kind of spinning the deal in a certain way that probably upsets the Iranian hardliners.
segments.zh: 特别是在美国这边，特朗普总统对批评很敏感，有时他会发表威胁伊朗代表团的言论，或以某种方式扭曲协议，这很可能激怒伊朗强硬派。

segments.en: And so I think what you have here is negotiators have a text, but their kind of hardliners on both sides are probably not entirely happy with the fact that there's a deal at all.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，谈判代表有文本，但双方强硬派可能对达成协议本身并不完全满意。

segments.en: And then you get these kinds of incidents where there's kind of tit for tat.
segments.zh: 然后就出现了这类以牙还牙的事件。

segments.en: It's still a ceasefire, unless and until these go beyond kind of one-for-one strikes, there's a very careful discipline, frankly, on the exchanges of fire that have taken place today.
segments.zh: 这仍然是停火，除非这些行动超越一对一的打击，坦率地说，今天发生的交火非常克制。

segments.en: If you see that start to spiral, then I think we're in a different territory.
segments.zh: 如果看到局势开始升级，那我们就进入不同局面了。

segments.en: And some of those threats from the President have come while negotiators were literally in the room together.
segments.zh: 总统的一些威胁言论是在谈判代表同处一室时发出的。

segments.en: Talk to us as somebody who's handled some of these sensitive negotiations, how difficult that can be to keep those talks on the rails when outside factors keep trying to push in.
segments.zh: 作为处理过敏感谈判的人，请谈谈当外部因素不断干扰时，维持谈判轨道有多难。

segments.en: It's a great question because I can tell you, right, when we were doing communications around Iran nuclear negotiations, sometimes we would go out and talk about the kinds of concessions that we were pushing for at the negotiating table.
segments.zh: 问得好，我可以告诉你，在围绕伊朗核谈判进行沟通时，有时我们会公开谈论我们在谈判桌上争取的让步。

segments.en: And the Iranian negotiators would tell us, hey, you're creating huge problems for me with the IRGC, the Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps, the more hard-line elements inside of my government.
segments.zh: 伊朗谈判代表会告诉我们，嘿，你给我的伊斯兰革命卫队和政府内强硬派制造了巨大麻烦。
